propositions: On agentic execution mode, the accumulated tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) rather than being cached after the first turn.

Only two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) are configured in cache_settings_for(), leaving anthropic_cache and bedrock_cache_messages unused despite existing in pydantic-ai 1.107.1.
The telemetry gate warn_if_cache_ineffective cannot detect this inefficiency because cache_read_tokens is nonzero from the system block cache hit, so the predicate never fires.

Anthropic and Bedrock APIs require different cache configuration keys: Anthropic uses anthropic_cache for automatic caching, while Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control and requires bedrock_cache_messages instead.
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical to the current implementation to avoid regression, as the fix applies only to agentic multi-turn flows.
